Problem: In the arithmetic sequence $\left\{a_{n}\right\}$, for any positive integer $n$, we have $a_{n+1} + a_{n} = 4n - 58$. Find $a_{2015}$.

<reflection>
The sequence is arithmetic, so $a_n=a_1+(n-1)d$ and $a_{n+1}=a_1+nd$. Substituting into the given relation gives $2a_1+(2n-1)d=4n-58$. Since this equality must hold for all positive integers $n$, comparing coefficients of $n$ and constants is valid.
The coefficient of $n$ in $2a_1+(2n-1)d$ is $2d$, not $2$; comparing correctly with $4n-58$ yields $2d=4$, not $2=4$.
Equate the coefficients correctly: set $2d=4$ and $2a_1-d=-58$, then solve for $a_1$ and compute $a_{2015}=a_1+2014d$.
</reflection>
